text: This solution, National Indemnity Insurance Program (NIIP) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Republic of the Philippines between Department of Finance (DOF), Bureau of the Treasury (BTr), Government Service Insurance System (GSIS), Department of Science and Technology (DOST), SEADRIF Insurance Company, Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), and Sompo Risk Management Inc.. The program was implemented in 2024 and focuses on collaboration, leveraging tech, and regulation.
